learning_outcomes.text: Harmonious combination of physical education and sports with intellectual activity
Adaptation for systematic independent practice of physical exercise
Formation of habits of discipline, punctuality, correctness

assessment_rules: Minimum performance standard requires performing simple jogging exercises and active presence in classes (7 lessons/sem.).
